tools.name: search-vouchers
tools.description: Live voucher codes and offers PriceDash lists for one UK shop or brand, up to five, with each code, end date, the day it was last checked at source, and a PriceDash link to the offer. Offers checked in the last 30 days come first.

tools.description: Live offers PriceDash lists across UK shops, one per shop, up to five: the newest, those ending within five days, those ending today, or those in one product category.
